newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 465/466.25/$.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 465/466.25/$.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat in a balanced market at 465.00/466.25 per dollar, traders said, although next week may see it firm again.
"If foreign funds continue to come in to buy stocks and Central Bank TEMs, the dollar could weaken again," said one trader.
Over the past two weeks the bolivar has firmed over two percent as portfolio inflows to the stock exchange and Central Bank paper have mopped-up bolivar supplies.
